name: Cocoen Before After Image Formatter
description: Field formatters that render two images as a draggable before/after comparison, using the Cocoen library.
project_description:
This module provides a new formatter for image and media image fields with beforeAfter effect to compare images.

 Cocoen module using Cocoen beforeAfter plugin 

 Instalation: 
 
 Download and enable module 
 Download plugin and extract to /libraries directory, correct path should be /libraries/cocoen/dist/js/cocoen.min.js 
 Select cocoen beforeAfter formater, remember that you have to upload 2 images or media 
 
 Supported versions: 
 
 8.x-1.x supports Cocoen 2.x 
 Cocoen 3.x is not supported - we can add a new branch to support this version 
 Back to top
